title: Safe self-update release framework (proposal-only): proposer, live-config guard, checklist, records, ADR.
what_changed: Added the release framework scaffolding: releases/ dir with RELEASE-RECORD-TEMPLATE.json, RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md, PROPOSAL-WORKFLOW.md, this example record; tools/release_proposer.py (proposal-only, never applies); tools/live_config_guard.py (blocks direct agent writes to protected live config outside the release flow); tests under tools/tests/; ADR-0006. No production behavior changed: no flags flipped, no crons edited, no credentials or money/risk settings touched. New framework files only.
why: Jarvis Core requires that self-improvements go through gates rather than free self-editing of production. This builds the minimal release framework so future self-updates are proposed, reviewed, canaried, and human-approved where dangerous, with no autonomous promotion path.

reviewer.independent_reviewer: pending (nightly-safe-update: docs/scaffolding, no production behavior change)
reviewer.notes: This release is the framework itself. It changes no live config. It is recorded as the example record demonstrating the format. Promotion of any FUTURE self-update flows through this system; this record does not itself promote anything live.

canary.plan: n/a for scaffolding with no production call path. The framework's own enforcement is proven by the test suite, not by a live canary.
canary.observed: Tests pass: proposer only proposes; guard blocks protected writes; record/checklist format validates.

rollback_command: git revert <commit-of-this-framework>  (removes releases/, tools/release_proposer.py, tools/live_config_guard.py, tools/tests/, ADR-0006; the framework is additive and inert until invoked, so reverting restores the prior state with no side effects).
release_notes: New safe self-update release framework (proposal-only). Future self-improvements are proposed via tools/release_proposer.py, reviewed against releases/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md, recorded in releases/records/, and promoted only by a human/reviewer. Direct agent writes to protected live config (feature-flags, crons, credentials, money/risk/trading, live prompts, permissions) are blocked by tools/live_config_guard.py outside an approved record. Nothing auto-promotes.
